articles.title: Indian Navy monitors safe transit of merchant vessels through Bab-el-Mandeb Strait
articles.summary: A mission-deployed Indian Navy unit monitored the safe transit of merchant vessels MV Union Mariner and MV Dagher through the critical Bab-el-Mandeb Strait on August 25. This action underscores the Indian Navy's commitment to ensuring maritime security and protecting vital international trade routes, reinforcing India's role as a responsible naval power in a strategically significant region.
